children: Belgium’s business confidence indicator increased by 1.1 point to -12.1 in September 2026, from -13.2 in August, contrasting with market expectations of a further decline to -13.5.

Sentiment improved in manufacturing (-12.2 vs -17.8), reflecting greater optimism in building materials and flat glass (-24.9 vs -45), the manufacture of ferrous and non-ferrous basic metals (-10.9 vs -34.9), and capital goods (-7.7 vs -14.6).
Confidence also improved in roofing activities (10.7 vs 9.9).

In contrast, pessimism deepened in construction-related services, including structural building work (-11.8 vs -7.7), construction installation (-8.3 vs -1.9), and building completion and finishing (-20 vs -10.4), as well as business-related services (-13.4 vs -1.4) and trade (-8.6 vs -5.6).

title: Belgium Business Pessimism Eases
